name: search_products
description: Search the Valio Aimo catalogue by product words, optionally filtered by claims and a needed-by date; returns a shortlist with product_id, name, sales unit, gross price, stock status and the earliest available date. Optional: build_quote finds the products itself, so use this when the buyer asks what is available or what something costs, then order with build_quote.

Claim.description:
Product claims, as the product data states them.

`lactose_free` means a lactose-free product only; a low-lactose product does not count.
Claim.title: Claim

name: get_customer_context
description: Get the signed-in buyer's company name, kitchen exclusions, usual items (with product_id and usual quantity), account language and the masked phone number the confirmation link goes to. Call it at the start if you don't already have them. The engine applies the exclusions to every line by itself.

name: search_recipes
description: Search the 2,091 Valio Aimo recipes by a dish, an ingredient or a free description, in Finnish or English, by meaning and by words. Optional filters: diet tags, all required (Finnish such as "laktoositon", "gluteeniton", "maidoton", "vegaaninen", or "lactose_free", "gluten_free", "milk_free", "vegan"), and an occasion (such as "lounasruoka", "buffet", "joulu" or "lunch"). Diet words in q filter too, and portion counts in q are ignored. Returns recipe_ids, Finnish names, default portions and diet tags. Use it when the buyer orders for a dish or a menu, then get_recipe.

name: get_recipe
description: Get one recipe scaled to the given number of portions: its ingredients (in Finnish) with amounts, and a product_id where an ingredient is linked to a product. To order it, send build_quote one line with recipe_ref {recipe_id, portions} and no ingredient_index, quantity the portions, unit piece and group the recipe name: the linked ingredients are ordered and the others are listed in not_ordered. The engine applies the kitchen's exclusions.

name: build_quote
description: Price the whole order. Call it once, with every line the buyer wants, only after they say the order is complete ("that's all") or ask for the price or a summary; never while they are still adding lines, and not after each line. In each line, text keeps the product words and any pack size the buyer said ("kevytmaito 1 l"), and product_id is only an id a tool returned for that product (a get_customer_context usual item, a search_products result or a recipe ingredient), never invented. A whole recipe is one line with recipe_ref (see get_recipe). Returns a decision (ready, needs_clarification or rejected), priced lines, flags, a clarification question or rejections, not_ordered (recipe ingredients the buyer gets elsewhere), and speak, a short summary in Finnish and English.

RecipeRef.description:
A line from a recipe (#34). Without `ingredient_index` the line is the whole recipe:
the quote service turns it into one line per ingredient with a product link and lists
the other ingredients in `not_ordered`.
RecipeRef.title: RecipeRef

RequestedUnit.description: The unit the buyer asked in. With `package`, the word is in `package_word`.
RequestedUnit.title: RequestedUnit

name: update_quote
description: Answer the engine's clarification or change a quote's lines; returns a new quote that replaces the old one. Send the quote_id and the full line list with the same line_ids: for a clarification, the asked line gets the chosen option's product_id and the other lines stay as they were. Answer the clarification with this call, not by searching for products yourself.

name: request_confirmation
description: Send the confirmation link for a ready quote to the buyer's own phone, the number on the account; no recipient can be given. Call it only after the buyer clearly says yes to getting the link. Nothing is ordered until the buyer confirms through the link, so never say the order is placed.

name: get_order_status
description: Get the status of one of the buyer's quotes or orders by quote_id: ready, pending_confirmation, confirmed (with the order number), cancelled, expired, or void (with the quote that replaced it).
